messages:
Alex Kim: quick update — ran the interleaved speculative decode on draft-quant-13b (4-bit) against the 2k eval slice. throughput improved ~1.8x token/s overall :chart_with_upwards_trend:, but we see a small quality delta on the safety+longform suites (avg BLEU-like proxy down ~0.7 points).
Maria Chen: nice perf. can you paste exact cmd and decode settings? curious if beam/sampling mix changed.
Alex Kim: sure — used the hybrid scheduler we sketched, speculative window=6, fallback threshold=0.44, temperature=0.9, topk=50. command: ```./run_decode --model draft-quant-13b --spec-window 6 --fallback-threshold 0.44 --temp 0.9 --topk 50 --seed 42 --batch 32```
Jia Patel: is the BLEU-ish hit concentrated on specific prompt types? e.g., instruction-following vs long-context summarization?
Alex Kim: good question. quick breakdown: instruction tasks ~no change, short QA ~0.1 drop, long-context summarization and safety-red-team prompts show the bulk of the delta. I suspect early speculative choices cause a subtle drift in phrase-level fluency for long outputs.
Tom Riley: can you dump a couple paired generations (greedy baseline vs speculative) for the same RNG seeds? helps eyeball failure modes. also include logits where speculation kicked in.
Alex Kim: posted a mini diff in the run artifact bucket: s3://redwood-dev/experiments/1735002468/pairs.tar.gz (contains seeds, outputs, logits, and timing per token).
Maria Chen: thanks. before we escalate, can we run an A/B with paired significance (bootstrap paired) on the 5 worst prompts and 1k random? want to know if 0.7 is noise. also ensure identical quantization seeds for the model.
Jia Patel: agree. also let's try lowering the spec-window to 4 and raising fallback threshold to 0.5 in one arm — hypothesis: smaller window reduces risky long-horizon commitments.
Tom Riley: +1. we should log the exact token index where fallback happened. that's been useful in past. add a small tracing tag in runtime: TRACE_SPEC_EVENT=1.
Alex Kim: will queue two reruns: (A) spec-window=4,fallback=0.5 (B) same as current but deterministic cache warmup on first 32 tokens. will attach paired outputs and timing. estimated wall 3h per run on a 8-GPU p3 cluster.
ops-bot: Job queued: job_id=run-1735002468-01, queued by Alex Kim. ETA ~3h.
Maria Chen: if the repeat confirms consistent quality regression, we should run a small human eval on the 50 worst regressions before touching rollout. automated metrics are noisy on longform.
Jia Patel: also capturing n-gram overlap and model confidence shift (avg token logprob) will help diagnose whether it's fluency vs factual divergence.
Alex Kim: noted. plan: run the two arms, compute paired delta distribution, gather top-50 regressions, push to human eval queue if median delta > 0.5 on our proxy. will report back in this thread with artifacts and a short triage doc.
Tom Riley: sounds good. tagging @infra-team for GPU time if needed. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: thanks Alex — appreciate the quick checkin.
Alex Kim: will post results here once jobs finish.
ops-bot: Job started: job_id=run-1735002468-01 on cluster p3-8 (provisioned by infra).
